current_milestone: Milestone 1: executable city/place sightseeing vertical slice

workstreams.summary: Coordinator, Planner and Chat accept 1–14 day trips with a grounded stop per initial day and bounded validation. Active admins configure provider/model, additive role prompts and bounded generation settings; each turn uses an immutable snapshot. Live 14-day model output and latency are unverified. Ollama remains the final fallback. Empty, thinking-only, truncated and invalid structured output now fail with safe classified errors; no retry or further provider is added, and the previous plan is preserved. Offline verification passed 294 tests with one optional PostgreSQL skip; all four Python quality checks passed. Live workload and deployment were not tested. Ollama thinking is explicitly disabled through ChatOllama reasoning=False; output budgets are unchanged. A direct synthetic live probe with think=False returned valid JSON, no thinking, done_reason=stop and 5 generated tokens at a 128-token cap. This is not deployed-app acceptance.

workstreams.state: remember-login PostgreSQL schema repaired; Auth0 browser QA pending
workstreams.summary: The landing offers an unchecked remember option. Ordinary sessions expire after 30 minutes idle; new opted-in sessions have no fixed server deadline and renew their browser cookie after a successful account check. Older opted-in sessions retain their 30-day limit; browsers can still delete or limit cookies. Backed-up, write-paused PostgreSQL migration added the required column; 55 older sessions defaulted to false. The restarted app is healthy and public /api/auth/me with an invalid cookie returns HTTP 200 unauthenticated. Live Auth0 and remembered browser return remain unverified.

development_workflow.summary: Five project skills and five development roles. CI configuration targets main pushes and uses repository-wide flake8; the main ruleset requires the GitHub Actions verify check. The Mac poller tracks main with its local deployment gate enabled, and waits for a successful push CI run before app-only deployment.
